title: The Ledger of Nagasaki's harbor
author: Noor Nakamura
blurb: Xanthe Zhou, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
